edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to the owner state variable in the Owned constructor, establishing privileged access.
msg.sender supplies the balance to debit in transfer.
msg.sender is the allowance granter in approve.
msg.sender drives the allowance check and debit in transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as owner of the allowance before the external callback in approveAndCall.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
require(msg.sender == newOwner) gates acceptOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier restricts transferAnyERC20Token to the contract owner.
approveAndCall performs an external call into the caller-supplied spender contract after updating allowance state.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into an owner-supplied token contract.
The external receiveApproval call executes while the allowed mapping has already been modified, enabling reentrant allowance manipulation.
A reentrant call from receiveApproval can re-enter transferFrom and mutate the balances mapping mid-execution.
The attacker-controlled spender parameter is the callee address of the unsafe external call.
The tokenAddress parameter is the callee address of the external transfer call.
totalSupply computes _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] with a raw unsigned subtraction.
The unchecked subtraction reads the _totalSupply state variable and can underflow.
transfer calls safeSub to guard the balance decrement against underflow.
transfer calls safeAdd to guard the balance increment against overflow.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for both sender and recipient.
transferFrom calls safeSub for both the balance and allowance decrements.
transferFrom calls safeAdd for the recipient balance increment.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping of the from and to accounts.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping entry of from and msg.sender.
approve writes the granted amount into the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the granted amount into the allowed mapping before the external call.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
The Zettabyte constructor sets the initial _totalSupply value.
The Zettabyte constructor credits the full supply into the balances mapping.
The Zettabyte constructor initializes the symbol state variable.
The Owned constructor writes the deployer address into the owner state variable.
transferOwnership stages the new owner address in newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner and requires msg.sender to match it.
acceptOwnership overwrites the owner state variable with newOwner and clears newOwner.
The to parameter flows into the recipient balance update in transfer.
The tokens parameter flows into the safeSub/safeAdd amounts in transfer.
The spender parameter keys the allowed mapping write in approve.
The tokens parameter is the allowance value written in approve.
The from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
The to parameter is the credited account in transferFrom.
The tokens parameter is the transfer and allowance amount in transferFrom.
The tokens parameter is the allowance amount in approveAndCall.
The data parameter is forwarded verbatim to the external receiveApproval call.
The tokens parameter is the amount forwarded to the external token transfer.
The _newOwner parameter is stored into the newOwner state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter only carries data into transfer; merge into the transfer function node.
Amount parameter only carries data into transfer; merge into the transfer function node.
Spender parameter is only used as the allowance key in approve; merge into approve.
Amount parameter is only the allowance value in approve; merge into approve.
Source address parameter only feeds transferFrom; merge into transferFrom.
Destination address parameter only feeds transferFrom; merge into transferFrom.
Amount parameter only feeds the arithmetic in transferFrom; merge into transferFrom.
The spender parameter is the callee of the unsafe external call and must be merged into that unsafe operation.
Amount parameter only sets the allowance in approveAndCall; merge into approveAndCall.
Payload parameter is only forwarded to the external callback in approveAndCall; merge into approveAndCall.
The tokenAddress parameter is the callee of the unsafe external call and must be merged into that unsafe operation.
Amount parameter only feeds the external token transfer; merge into transferAnyERC20Token.
New owner parameter is only written to newOwner inside transferOwnership; merge into transferOwnership.
